zh.title: 捷藍航空宣布開通佛羅里達至八個城市新航線
zh.summary: 捷藍航空宣布自FLL開通八條新直飛航線；再規劃六條新航線
body: 捷藍航空（JetBlue）於2026年9月7日宣布，自羅德岱堡好萊塢國際機場（FLL）開通八條新的直飛航線，目的地城市包括巴爾的摩、夏洛特、克里夫蘭、納什維爾、底特律、休士頓、芝加哥及波多黎各首府城市邦斯。
捷藍航空並計劃在未來數月內開通前往印第安那也是、聖地牙哥、俄亥俄州哥倫布市、無夏洛特、哥倫比亞卡利、哥倫比亞巴蘭基亞等地的航線，相關服務須待進一步確認。
航空公司表示，計入這八條新航班後，捷藍航空在羅德岱堡的每日出發航班將超過125班，非直飛目的地將超過55個，是該航空公司在這座機場史上最大的班次。捷藍航空並預期今冬每日航班數可達約150班。

en.title: JetBlue launches eight new non-stop routes from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood
en.summary: JetBlue announced eight new non-stop routes from FLL and plans six more; over 125 daily departures
body: JetBlue announced on September 7, 2026, the launch of eight new non-stop routes from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) to Baltimore, Charlotte, Cleveland, Nashville, Detroit, Houston, Chicago, and Ponce, Puerto Rico.

The airline also plans to start flights to Indianapolis, San Diego, Columbus, Ohio, Cali, Colombia, Barranquilla, Colombia, and Caracas, Venezuela in the coming months, though the Caracas service is yet to be confirmed.

Including the eight new flights, JetBlue says it will now operate more than 125 daily departures to over 55 nonstop destinations from Fort Lauderdale, the largest schedule in the airline’s history at the airport. The airline added that it expects to reach approximately 150 daily flights from Fort Lauderdale this winter.

zh.title: IATA發布2027年版貨運與地勤作業手冊
zh.summary: IATA發布2027年版貨運與地勤作業手冊；修訂危規、電池及活體動物規定
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）已發布2027年版貨運與地面作業關鍵業界手冊，內容納入多項重大變更與修訂，以配合全球標準的演進。
手冊修訂重點涵蓋危險物品規則（DGR）、電池運送規則（BSR）與活體動物規則（LAR）。DGR部分包含提升包裝要求明確性、備用電池與行動電源的限制與要求，以及超過300Wh之鋰電池行動輔具的新營運者義務等。
BSR部分納入混合電池（含鋰離子與鈉離子電池芯）的規範，並修訂包裝指示；LAR則新增特定無病原體實驗動物列入物種清單，並更新航空貨艙清潔與消毒程序。
IATA亦提到，其手冊相關的數位工具將逐步運用人工智慧（AI），以協助作業流程數位化。

en.title: IATA Releases 2027 Cargo and Ground Operations Manuals
en.summary: IATA releases 2027 editions of cargo and ground operations manuals; updates DGR, BSR and LAR rules
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) has released the updated 2027 editions of key industry manuals for cargo and ground operations, incorporating major changes and revisions to align with evolving global standards.

Highlights include revisions to the Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) for clarity on packaging, restrictions and requirements for spare batteries and power banks, and requirements for lithium battery-powered mobility aids, including new operator obligations for devices exceeding 300Wh.

The Battery Shipping Regulations (BSR) now include provisions for hybrid batteries with lithium-ion and sodium-ion cells, and clarify exclusions from the 4-cell/2-battery limit for certain battery shipments.

The Live Animals Regulations (LAR) add specific pathogen-free laboratory animals to species listings, standardized terminology, and updated aircraft cargo compartment cleaning and disinfection procedures.
IATA also described enhanced digital tools, which will increasingly leverage artificial intelligence (AI), to link its manuals more efficiently to industry processes.
